heading: 4.2 `unit scalar`
text:
### 4.2 `unit scalar` [LUNI.4.2]

```
unit_scalar ::= 'unit' 'scalar' NAME 'storage' NAME unit_label? NEWLINE
```

`unit_label` is [LUNI.4.3]'s. Declares a dimensionless scalar group. Same mechanics as `unit dimension` — units
within the group are interchangeable, affine conversions apply — but signals to
readers and tools that the quantity has no physical dimension.

#### Angle — a dimensionless scalar group

`angle` is declared as a `unit scalar`, not a `unit dimension`. Radians are
physically dimensionless (arc length / radius; units cancel). This makes `exp()`,
`sin()`, `cos()`, `tan()` accept angle values naturally without special carve-outs.

All angle values are stored in radians (base unit), so `45_deg` and
`0.7854_radian` are the same value converted. The `°` / `′` / `″`
glyph aliases take the separator as every unit does, optionally
([LUNI.3.2.1]): `45°` and `45_°` are both degree.
